claims.claim: MPNet combines dependency among predicted tokens with auxiliary full-sentence positional information.
claims.verification_note: Both contributions corroborated in Microsoft Research explainer.

claims.claim: MPNet pretraining conditions on previous real tokens in permutation plus mask symbols for all target positions, rather than naively adding MLM and PLM losses.
claims.verification_note: Preserves distinction x_z<t vs M_z>c and only sums t=c+1...n.

claims.claim: Position compensation supplies masked placeholders and position information for all predicted positions.
claims.verification_note: Official explanatory figure cross-checks main paper §2.3.

claims.claim: MPNet uses separate masks for query and content streams to allow dependencies while preventing target leakage.
claims.verification_note: Illustrative demo summarizes sets, not full implementation masks.

claims.claim: MPNet official release provides model code and pretrained checkpoints.
claims.verification_note: Official code link in paper abstract; no benchmark reproduction claimed.

claims.claim: MPNet reported comparison and ablation on GLUE and SQuAD, including position compensation.
claims.verification_note: No table scores repeated without protocol; avoid conflating evaluation splits.
